correctness.rationale: Four distinct time samples including zero give global injection of the constrained two-exponential survival mixture by a proved exponential zero lemma. Strict concavity of L(z)=integral_0^1 z^s ds makes the survival Jacobian rank three exactly when visits differ. An analytic alternant/Vandermonde factor and positive history-probability integral factors give a uniform Fisher T^8 expansion whose shape has precisely two nondegenerate maxima at (1 ± 1/sqrt(3))/2; full statement stays within open parameter boundaries. The standalone checker independently recomputes multinomial score Fisher information and verifies symbolic moments in 2,269 assertions.

originality.rationale: Royle–Link 2006 supplies the false-positive occupancy mixture, Miller et al. 2011 supplies improved survey observation methods, and Clement 2016 studies number/type of visits with different objective. Closest published-finding corpus published theorem b8f26f454426 is no-false-positives and two parameters, with small-budget equal split; the new three-parameter local Fisher problem is singular at equality and has universal 21–79 asymptotic. The mixture Chebyshev step is acknowledged as prior. Specific historical overlap risks remain.
residual_risks: The full 2006 Royle–Link article was not retrieved; only its public abstract and secondary descriptions were accessible. It could contain an undiscovered special variable-duration observation design.

Unlocated older general exponential-mixture optimal design theory could implicitly cover the exact asymptotic constant; internet and published-finding corpus searches do not certify universal historical priority.
Ecological interpretation as actual occupied/unoccupied sites is not separately identifiable from competing persistent detection-heterogeneity interpretations without the process assumption.

value.rationale: Two unverified binary visits are common economical observation primitives. A third unknown false-alarm intensity makes equal-duration designs completely lose one information dimension, while unequal effort restores global model parameter identification and admits a precise universal short-budget 21–79 allocation. This yields a motivated exact sampling benchmark absent from count-of-visits tables; ecological and finite-sample caveats are explicit.
